cohort: 343 patients undergoing 380 assisted reproductive technology (ART) cycles with the GnRH antagonist protocol and achieving a clinical pregnancy
finding: Independent risk factors for ectopic pregnancy after ART using the GnRH antagonist protocol included GnRH agonist trigger, higher number of oocytes aspirated, insemination technique (IVF vs ICSI), and prior cesarean section.
mod_finding: Prior Cesarean section was found to be an independent risk factor for ectopic pregnancy.
